title: Shows in Berlin in English - Quick Summary
items: **You have three ways into a Berlin theatre night without German**: shows with no words at all, German theatre with English surtitles, and stages that simply play in English. All venue facts checked on 2 September 2026.

**The easiest win is a no-words show**: the Grand Show **BLINDED by DELIGHT** at Friedrichstadt-Palast (premiered October 2025, runs to June 2027), contemporary circus **Kintsugi** at Chamäleon in the Hackesche Höfe (until 17 January 2027), and the varieté show **DISCO** at Wintergarten (until 14 February 2027).

**Maxim Gorki Theater is the most English-friendly German theatre**: its German-language productions run with English surtitles, premieres excepted. The **Berliner Ensemble and Schaubühne surtitle several marked performances every month**; Deutsches Theater does selected dates.

**Surtitle tickets cost nothing extra**, and straight theatre is far cheaper than the big shows. At the Berliner Ensemble, sit in the balconies or from row 13 to read the surtitles comfortably; students pay EUR 9.
**Blue Man Group is gone.** It closed at the end of 2025 after 18 years, and the Bluemax Theater now hosts changing productions, mostly in German. Ignore any guide still recommending it.
**For all-English rooms**, check English Theatre Berlin in Kreuzberg and the English improv and standup nights at Comedy Café Berlin in Neukölln.
